redistribution_classes.meaning: AGID-created metadata and non-production fixtures only.
Public official pages, guidance, or metadata used as validation receipts; access does not imply bulk redistribution rights.
An exact official open-data resource whose licence, attribution, endpoint, schema, coverage, validity, CRS, and digest are pinned.
Search, account, permissioned, paid, or otherwise restricted material retained and redistributed only as permitted.
Personal, title/right, unclear-rights, or non-redistributable evidence may detect discrepancies but cannot become authoritative public output.

artifact_partitions.rule: Slovenská pošta assertions retain five-digit text, display spacing, returned street/municipality/delivery context, query scope, capture time, interface/terms version, and digest; syntax never creates assignment.

Register adries address Points and null geometry remain membership evidence and do not create a surface. Only a separately reviewed rights-cleared polygon product with complete assignment/non-area reconciliation, method, parameters, members, exclusions, validation, uncertainty, validity, and lineage may be published as derived; Point buffers, hulls, Voronoi/raster cells and administrative, cadastral, building, office or synthetic substitutes are prohibited.
Register adries identity, point geometry, street, entrance, building identifier, validity, and PSČ evidence remain separate assertions.
Register building relation, ZBGIS footprint, cadastral parcel, title/right record, and address identity remain distinct; protected fields never enter public artifacts.
Regions, districts, municipalities, municipality parts, cadastral territories, and geographical names never create PSČ membership.
Post office, PoštaPOINT, BalíkoBOX, route, search availability, and delivery eligibility remain time-stamped evidence separate from assignment and geometry.
Addressees, residents, owners, rightsholders, tenants, occupants, apartments/units, title/restriction records, phones, credentials, and delivery instructions never enter public artifacts.
Non-production fixture metadata only; never promotion evidence.

m2_audit_2026_08_31.operator_search: The public Slovenská pošta UI uses a bounded street/municipality address endpoint with limit 5. An exact non-personal search returned two codes, while a direct 81108 query returned none; this is not a complete assignment or exception denominator.
m2_audit_2026_08_31.operator_access_points: The exact generated 2026-08-30T18:00:00 XML contains 2,449 offices/access points and only Point service context, not PSČ areas or a complete delivery-assignment denominator.
m2_audit_2026_08_31.register_addresses: Eight current daily NUTS3 metadata records state no access limitation and CC BY 4.0 for author work and database rights. The exact 127,488,925-byte SK010 GeoJSON contains 160,897 address features: 158,803 Point and 2,094 null geometry, with zero Polygon or MultiPolygon.
m2_audit_2026_08_31.promotion_result: blocked: no current complete operator assignment/exception denominator, operator public-serving grant, fixed PSČ Polygon/MultiPolygon product, complete code reconciliation, approved immutable artifact or real SK API/UI area path was established
